L1.name: Calendar-marker alignment and batch-composition dependence
L1.structural_mechanism: TimeMixer channel-independent branch flattens(b,c) but repeats markers in(c,b)order via repeat; batch1 unaffected
L1.estimand: Mean absolute change of one fixed query forecast betweenB1 andquery+127historical contexts, averaged overH96/C7 and registered seeds
L1.cohort: 512 validation queries, scattered at preregistered indices; resample dense original hourly origin calendar and then retain query membership
L1.pvalue_method: Centered paired moving-block bootstrap at null boundary, one-sided; Holm across three tests
L1.secondary_metric: Change in MSE on the same query targets; direction not assumed; marker-free inference without retraining as mechanism control
L1.scope: Implementation-level limitation of the pinned original with calendar markers; not proof of future-price leakage or a theorem about all TimeMixer variants
L1.Bitcoin_transfer: Inherited Bitcoin inputs have no calendar markers; this defect does not by itself affect that adapter or establish an E3 research contribution

L2.name: Observable high-variability context error heterogeneity
L2.threshold: q75 across eligible TRAIN windows only, calculated before validation errors
L2.estimand: Mean acrossseeds of RMSE onhighvariability validation origins minusRMSE onremainingvalidationorigins
L2.cohort: all2785 original validation origins, fixed chronological inference batches128(drop_lastFalse forpilotdiagnostics)
L2.pvalue_method: Centered paired moving-block bootstrap192h, Holm across3models; sensitivity96/384
L2.scope: Exploratory hypothesis of a transferable regime limitation, not a promised failure or evidence of causal architecture effect
L2.negative_result_policy: If CI/effect do not support the hypothesis, label limitation not demonstrated; do not select a new regime threshold or replace it after results
L2.E3_link: Only a supported predictive limitation could motivate further regime-aware/multiscale mechanisms; requires BitcoinD7-specific validation later

parameters.bootstrap_method: circular moving-block bootstrap on original hourly forecast origins; wrapped blocks are part of the declared approximation
